notes.title: Fugue of Delights – Coming July 23rd
notes.content:
[h2][b]Mark the date.[/b]
[b]Fugue of Delights, the fifth chronicle in the Enygmage universe, will be released on July 23rd.[/b]
[i]A deeper descent into the textures of desire, delirium, and dream.[/i][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Elylah returns[/b] — wounded, radiant, and relentless.
Vulpes burns. The daemonic dream fractures.
And you are not ready.[/p][p]This new installment brings:[/p][list][*][p]Refined artwork in chiaroscuro dreamscapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Tense erotic encounters and layered choices.[/p][/*][*][p]A descent into the heart of art, lust, and memory.[/p][/*][/list][p]The fugue is a spiral.
You won’t know what you’ve lost until it ends.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Add to your wishlist now and be the first to descend.
[/i]
[i]The stage is set. The curtain trembles.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686665/3ab9953b36bdcf91105a7ec17ea096f97278aaf0.png"][/img][/h2]
